explanation: Compared with Prime Curios 4208 (t5k.org: 'Harvey A. Dubner conjectured that all even numbers greater than 4208 are the sum of two prime numbers that have a twin'). IsTwinPrime p is 'p prime and p-2 or p+2 prime' (natural subtraction is harmless: for p ≤ 3, p-2 ∈ {0,1} is not prime, while 3 is correctly a twin via 5). The statement asks for twin primes p, q with p + q = n for every even n > 4208. Faithful.
